description: A protruding nail head was found in the crew quarter floor platform on Sol 1.
response: The Engineer hammered it flat immediately.
lesson: Day 1 hab walkthrough must include a floor inspection — particularly platform edges and stairways. Falls and penetrating injuries in a remote Arctic location are serious and slow to evacuate.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.6 Logistics and safety, lines 797-802. Register Crew tag: 'C16'. Sol: explicit: 'found in crew quarter floor platform on Sol 1'. Confidence (B) rationale: brief daily-report entry; classified Near-Miss since the hazard was found and fixed before anyone was injured.
